Freeze exact marker realizations or a deterministic mapping for every eligible item, account for their teacher turns together with PRESENT_AGAIN, TRAIN_MORE, TRAIN_LONGER, and REPLAY_LESSON under the global cap, and define the bounded terminal transition on cap exhaustion (for example defer_and_revisit or alarm freeze).
